subject.title: fix(whatsapp): prevent concurrent source account startup failures

question: Should this PR become the canonical fix for the WhatsApp source-loader race, replacing the overlapping open implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109526?
rationale: Both branches address the same observed failure with overlapping lazy-import changes, while this branch has stronger structural regression coverage and the related branch has direct live two-account proof; selecting one is a maintainer ownership decision.

options.title: Choose this shared-loader implementation
options.body: Run the two-account source-checkout scenario against this head, then land it as the single loader boundary and retire the overlapping branch.

options.title: Prefer the related narrower implementation
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109526 as the canonical path if its direct-probe plus memoization shape is preferred after comparison.

options.title: Combine only the proven pieces
options.body: Ask for one narrow replacement that retains one loader owner and carries forward live source-startup proof.

recommendation.title: Choose this shared-loader implementation
recommendation.body: Run the two-account source-checkout scenario against this head, then land it as the single loader boundary and retire the overlapping branch.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-member contributor who owns the current shared-loader proposal and can clarify its intended ownership boundary.
